Lemma
[Distinctness of the lifted multiples of a geodesic loop] Source: cheeger-gromov-taylor:page-0033 ↗ lem:pullback-ball ↗ lem:pullback-unique-minimizers

In the setting of Lemma lem:pullback-unique-minimizers ($\rho _*=1$, $|K(P)|\le 1$ on $(B,\tilde g)$), let $\gamma $ be a geodesic loop at $p$ of length $2\ell >0$, smooth on the open parameter interval, and let $N\ge 1$ be an integer with $2\ell N\le 1/256$. Then the points \[ E(\gamma ^0)=0,\ E(\gamma ^1),\ \ldots ,\ E(\gamma ^N) \] (where $\gamma ^m$ denotes the $m$-fold concatenation) are pairwise distinct points of $\overline{B(0,1/256)}$, all mapping to $p$ under $\exp _p$.
